|lore=Native of Chandrila. Leader of the Alliance. A former member of the Imperial Senate where she was a formidable opponent to then-Senator Palpatine. Friend of Bail Organa.
|game_text=Agenda: rebellion. Deploys -1 aboard your capital starship. Once per turn, while in a senate majority (or Stolen Data Tapes on table), may take your just drawn battle destiny into hand. Once per game, may deploy Chandrila from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Senator Mon Mothma (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-Senator_Mon_Mothma-2020-07-12-fdfe14b.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-L-Senator_Mon_Mothma-2020-07-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-Senator_Mon_Mothma-2019-12-06-errata-slip.png]], 6 December 2019) → [[File:V4-L-Senator_Mon_Mothma-2020-07-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-Senator_Mon_Mothma-2020-07-12-fdfe14b.gif]], 12 July 2020). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E”, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Senator Mon Mothma]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-senatormonmothma022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/senatormonmothma.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Light/large/senatormonmothma.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Mon Mothma”. Text: “Agenda: rebellion. Deploys free aboard your capital starship. Once per turn, while in a senate majority (or Stolen Data Tapes on table), may take your just drawn battle destiny into hand. Once per game, may deploy Chandrila from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Senator Mon Mothma (Errata)]]): PC errata sheet slip (december2019errata.pdf, page 2), PDF dated 6 December 2019<ref name="slip-monmothma-dec2019">Players Committee errata sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/december2019errata.pdf#page=2 december2019errata.pdf], page 2; the date is the PDF's creation date (6 December 2019).</ref>. '''What changed:''' “rebellion. Deploys free aboard your” → “rebellion. Deploys -1 aboard your”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•Mon Mothma” → “Mon Mothma” (uniqueness dot removed); a different printing: the errata sheet slip (printed for sleeving over the card) replaces the card image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Mon Mothma”. Text: “Agenda: rebellion. Deploys -1 aboard your capital starship. Once per turn, while in a senate majority (or Stolen Data Tapes on table), may take your just drawn battle destiny into hand. Once per game, may deploy Chandrila from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Once per turn, while in a senate majority (or Stolen Data Tapes on table), may take your just drawn battle destiny into hand. Once per game, may deploy Chandrila from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
